name: idea-ship
description: A lean software factory for small teams and solo builders: six agent skills that take an idea to a merged pull request, with the Linear issue as the thread.

plugins.name: idea-ship
plugins.description: The factory loop: setup once per project, then ideate, spec, build, ship, and feature to run a whole feature. Linear is the thread, sessions are disposable, you step in at most four times per ticket.
